first_page_excerpt: Introduction Continual demand is placed on the semiconductor industry for increased microcontroller performance and complexity, as well as cost reduction. This requires the development of microcontrollers with both high-density design technology and higher clock frequencies. These factors have intrinsically increased the noise emission and noise sensitivity of microcontroller devices. Application developers must therefore apply EMC "hardening” techniques in their firmware design, PCB layout, and at system level. This application note explains the microcontroller EMC features and compliance standards to help application designers reach the optimum level of EMC performance.
